params.val: suppresses the effect of every other Pokémon's ability on the field while the holder remains active with this ability

the other Pokémon holds an Ability Shield (that Pokémon's ability is unaffected), OR that Pokémon is a Tatsugiri currently "commanding" from inside an active Dondozo (cannot be suppressed while commanding)

ADDED real exceptions previously missing entirely -- verified against Showdown data/abilities.ts (neutralizinggas): Ability Shield fully blocks the suppression for its holder; a commanding Tatsugiri is exempt. Also has special one-time interactions when it activates: an Illusion holder's disguise is forced to end immediately, and a Slow Start holder's volatile is removed outright (not merely suppressed) since Slow Start's timer state would otherwise desync.
